raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the data center in Iași"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be a UPS"
      role subject ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "report battery fault"
      role subject ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  mode every
  quantifier at_least 2
